name: Devin Carter

comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Ausar Thompson
comment: Thompson exited Friday's game with an undisclosed injury and did not return, finishing with four points (2-5 FG, 0-1 3Pt), three rebounds, four assists, one steal, one block and three turnovers across 19 minutes in a 128-111 win over the Heat.

name: Jalen Duren
comment: Duren (thigh) exited Friday's 128-111 win over the Heat in the second quarter and did not return, finishing with four points (2-4 FG), six rebounds, three assists, one steal and one block across 10 minutes.

name: Brandin Podziemski
comment: Podziemski (back) told reporters Friday that he will not play in the second leg of the Warriors' back-to-back set Saturday against the Suns, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

name: Stephen Curry
comment: Curry told reporters after Friday's loss to the Grizzlies that he will "probably not" play against the Suns on Saturday, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

name: Charles Bassey
comment: Bassey (knee) is out for Friday's game versus the Grizzlies.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Steven Adams

name: Bradley Beal
